Specification: This module specifies a very small state machine with two variables, x and S. The initial state sets x to 0 and S to the set {1,2}, and the next-state relation allows a step only when x = 0 and there exists some n in S such that the sequential action composition A(n) \cdot B(n) is taken while S remains unchanged. The temporal specification asserts Init together with the standard safety-style formula [][Next]_<<S, x>>, so the file models an action system using action composition rather than fairness or liveness conditions.
